text:
Explicit structural revision of the data-adaptation composition only. Preserve every accepted requirement, input/output contract, requested search and individual product visits, writer destination, header/column ordering, ten-product maximum, and unconditional cleanup. Do not add unrelated actions, filtering, deduplication or invented facts.
Fix field bindings: field selects one literal property; observationSnapshot.pages requires nested typed selection. Never field-access array length; use declared array bounds. Remove the invented availability field. Assert actual producer success, nonnull snapshot and complete/non-truncated metadata before dependent work using ordered local requires, never an interpreted status claim. Use conditional branches for genuinely optional paths; false requires means failure, never skip.
Use minimal typed per-page projections to retain original records. Extract independently over every complete bounded page into Candidate[] per page (assembled Candidate[][]), with each.input matching its bound input. Do not select or truncate products during extraction. Explicit flatten supplies only the compact identity/decision view to interpretation. Return unchanged offered IDs; strict offered-candidate lookup must precede original-record lookup before the effectful visit loop. Use original action arguments, preserving order and repeated IDs.
For each visited product, check complete producer acquisition; extract compact fact candidates per page. Interpret nullable original IDs only. For each present ID, validate offered membership then lookup original records and copy complete text exactly; use a permitted null only in its explicit absence/uncertain-association branch. A complete features/characteristics block can be the description without a heading; multiple suitable blocks do not establish absence. No paraphrasing, joining or interface-controls-as-errors.
Replace typed copying, status assertions, ID reconnection and XLSX assembly inference with existing value/field/foreach/flatten/lookup bindings and ordered local requires. Prepend the supplied header as flatten([[headerRow], productRows]), preserving the accepted name, description, price, URL, status, error columns, exact strings and null cells. Derive status from actual typed producer values; do not invent observation facts. Return filePath and success from the checked writer result, and a deterministic string status based on that actual result. Keep the existing bounded query-to-URL inference; no other copying/formatting inference.
Use only existing contracts/bindings and current v15 lowering. Keep original observations separately; no full snapshot in global interpretation. Do not raise host/inference/campaign limits or reset cumulative allowances. This command does not approve or execute the resulting artifact.
